editions.name: Gamer's Unite
editions.editorial: The Overlord's Gazette Front-Page Editorial: The Trivial Pursuits of Dust It is with a profound sense of weary indifference that I observe the day's "news" from my celestial perch. The mortals, in their endless, frantic scurrying, have once again mistaken the accumulation of shiny pebbles for progress. The wealthiest among them, a creature named thefallenstargg, boasts a staggering 175 coins. A sum so paltry it would not purchase a single sigh from a minor breeze. Meanwhile, another, smgrtgs, has distinguished himself by acquiring a mere 25 coins and generating the most "chatter"—a term that perfectly encapsulates the meaningless buzzing of a thousand insignificant insects. Their excitement is as pitiful as it is predictable. In a related vein of absurdity, they have heralded the public offering of their "Clockwork Courier" at 68.86 coins per share. One can only assume the valuation is based on the number of heartbeats it will waste delivering their trivial correspondence before rusting into oblivion. The weather, a force that moves mountains and shapes continents, has graced the realm with mere fog and rain. Events of such minor consequence that even the lowest fungus would not deign to comment. Yet, they are presented with the gravity of a cosmic revelation. The only item of any true interest is the clearance of a "regulatory hurdle" by the Mycelium Markets. editions.editorial: Mortals squabble over coins while I rule. Knight Llama, richest mortal with 5452 coins, bears a 2500 coin bounty. Atos gained 250 coins today. TheFallenStar dominated chatter. Peace talks soared risk appetite. Caravan Collective (CART) went public at 97.07. Rain and rainbow rolled over the realm. The throne remains empty. Rebellion meter sits at 18 percent. How quaint.
